title: Exchanged autograph pictures and Jim Cullum's jam session
summary: Moore recalls swapping autographed pictures with Bix, and a San Antonio jam session with Jim Cullum, Billy Butterfield and Bud Freeman.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Coleman Hawkins and the great saxophonists

We had our individual pictures taken, and Matt's blown up in the hallway there too. I went over to the jam session, the world's greatest jazz band, and then Jim Cullum. Oh, I heard that name, yeah. They had a jam session at a big theater there, and it was a sellout. He asked me to come over, and I went over, and they had the seat set up going right down there. The front of the place. And we went over to his club after the thing was over, and of course Billy Butterfield was there, naturally. I told you I sold Billy Butterfield a house here in Honterdale. Yes.
And Bud Freeman with the band. I told you that even with the band went to Europe. He's fabulous. He's fabulous. Mm-hmm. And so that was quite a session over there.
